# Capability Matrix

<!-- Generated by `python tools/capability_matrix.py --write` from the language and domain
     catalogs and the built-in analyzer registry. Do not edit by hand:
     tests/test_documentation.py fails when this file is out of date. -->

PDT recognizes 128 languages and formats and runs 47 built-in analyzers over 67 analyzer domains. Recognition, structure and semantics are separate levels, and a language is listed at the level its code paths actually reach.

## Levels and their limits

| Level | Languages | What it provides | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|
| semantic | 1 | Syntax tree, qualified symbols, calls resolved through imports, receiver classes stated or inferred, inter-procedural taint | No run-time types (dependency injection, `getattr`) |
| structure | 28 | Definitions, calls, imports and references from a linear-time structural lexer, refined by a Tree-sitter grammar where provisioned | No types, overloads, macro expansion or templates |
| optional parser | 41 | Syntax-tree metrics, declarations and imports when the Tree-sitter grammar is provisioned (`tree-sitter-language-pack`) | Nothing beyond recognition without the grammar; PDT never downloads one |
| inventory | 58 | Recognized and counted; read by the format-specific analyzers listed | No code model |

Analyzers are listed for a language when they declare it. `api-endpoints`, `nosql-intelligence`, `observability-intelligence`, `secret-patterns`, `secure-code-patterns` and `test-discovery` read every source language and are not repeated on source rows. Format analyzers that select files by name (manifests, lockfiles, configuration, CI and archives) appear in the domain table. Fixtures counts the test modules that name a file of the language.

## Analyzer domains

0 implemented, 67 partial and 0 planned. A domain is `implemented` when its scope is covered end to end, `partial` when an analyzer covers part of it.
